data.title: 伊什塔尔 · 神泉沐浴的金纱独奏·「女神的入浴，是要收观赏费的」
data.description: 【神殿神泉·夜】女神的私浴时间。伊什塔尔斜倚在神泉池边，金纱薄裙湿透贴身，透出神圣又危险的曲线。她的指尖在水下缓缓抚过自己，红瞳迷离地睨向你躲闪的方向——「女神的入浴……是要收观赏费的。怎么，看了一半就想走？……那就把尾款……用别的……嗯……方式付清……」
data.action: 斜倚池边湿透金纱，水下手指自抚，红瞳迷离睨视
data.lighting: 神泉水汽与金纱的水光反照
data.camera: medium shot, divine spring, wet translucent veil, sensual solo framing
data.promptProse: During the goddess's private bath, Ishtar reclines against the rim of the sacred spring in a gold-veiled gown soaked to translucence, the wet fabric outlining curves divine and dangerous alike. One hand glides beneath the water over herself while her red eyes glance sidelong at your hiding spot, naming the viewing fee for a goddess's bath and offering to collect the balance by other means. Sensual solo composition, wet translucent veil, cinematic lighting, steam, detailed spring background.
